name: Anangu Tjukurpa ancestral landscape creation (publicly documented)
source_label: Public Anangu / Uluru-Kata Tjuta Tjukurpa descriptions

earliest_archaeological_evidence.note: Deep regional occupation evidence does not date the specific Tjukurpa narratives or currently practiced content.

earliest_written_attestation.note: This record deliberately does not assign an 'earliest written' date from outsider contact; it relies on current public Traditional Owner/government descriptions of living Tjukurpa.

tradition_internal_claim.note: Public Anangu descriptions locate the creative actions of ancestral beings in Tjukurpa, an ongoing law/cosmology embodied in landscape, ceremony, story, and responsibility rather than a Western calendar chronology.

estimated_oral_origin.method: No defensible absolute date exists for the origin of the specific publicly documented Tjukurpa material; regional antiquity is not used as a story date.

dating.dating_summary: Tjukurpa is a living Anangu law/cosmology whose publicly documented creation material is not assigned a calendar origin. Regional deep-time occupation and story age are kept separate.

notes: Uses only public-facing material. It does not expose restricted knowledge, does not treat 'Dreamtime' as one pan-Aboriginal story, and does not generalize Anangu Tjukurpa to other Aboriginal nations.
